ruleDefinitions.name: PSScriptPolicyTest Creation By Uncommon Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of the "PSScriptPolicyTest" PowerShell script by an uncommon process. This file is usually generated by Microsoft Powershell to test against Applocker.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX(".*\\_\\_PSScriptPolicyTest\\_.*") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\-preview\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\dsac\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\sdiagnhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\ServerManager\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wsmprovhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\sdiagnhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$")))
